description: NASA FIRMS VIIRS satellite fire detections of the last 48 hours in a bounding box up to 10°×10°, strongest first, with fire radiative power in MW. Use it for wildfires right now near a place or in a country: bbox is west,south,east,north in degrees — longitude first (Portugal ≈ -9.6,36.9,-6.1,42.2).

bbox.description: Bounding box west,south,east,north in degrees, at most 10° on each side, e.g. 29,36,33,38 (around Antalya).

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

name: get_active_fires
title: Active Fires In An Area
